title: pteris cretica var. stenophylla
intro: Pteris cretica var. stenophylla, commonly known as Chinese fern, is a plant species within the Pteris genus. It is used in traditional medicine, valued for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Pteris cretica var. stenophylla include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit hepatoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
